subject: Models for two primary periods with unequal secondary periods

messages.author: 9743508ad656e4da
messages.subject: Models for two primary periods with unequal secondary periods
parts:
Hello all,

I have a dataset of reptile observations from two visual encounter survey periods, conducted in 2021 and 2022. Each of the 21 sites were surveyed twice in the 2021 period, and five times in the 2022 period.

Is it possible to incorporate both survey periods in, e.g., pcountOpen without truncating the 2022 dataset (five secondary periods) to match the limit of the 2021 dataset (two secondary periods)?

Kind regards,

Kurt

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Models for two primary periods with unequal secondary periods
parts:
Dear Kurt,

yes, I think you just have to 'fill up' the data set with missing values in surveys 3-5 for the 2021 data.

Best regards  --- Marc
